text: school board meeting for a closed session begin with item 1.02 remote participation i've been notified that denise corbo would like to remotely participate in tonight's school board meeting miss corbo could you please state your location if anyone is present with you and whether this is a medical or personal matter i am home i am alone under policy 2420 i'm asking for remote meeting participation due to an ongoing disability and medical condition as recommended by hrtd under federal ADA disability law. Thank you. At this time, I will entertain a motion to approve Ms.

Corbo's remote participation for a health or medical matter. So moved. Moved by Mr. Morris. Is there a second? Second. Seconded by Mr. Beatty. Is there any discussion? Seeing none, all those in favor of the motion, please raise your hands and say aye. Those opposed, please raise your hands and say nay. Nay. Those abstaining. That motion will fail 3312 with Serotkin, Sheridan, and Reeser opposed, Ms. Ogadegbe abstaining, and Corvo and Mejedevi absent for the vote.

Ms. Corvo, would you like to request to participate due to a personal matter tonight? No, since there won't be any voting, I am opting not to use that. Thank you. Okay, thank you. With that, we will move to item two on our agenda, the closed session.

I move that the Loudoun County School Board recess this public meeting and enter into a closed meeting pursuant to section 2.2-3712 of the Code of Virginia for the following: personnel information regarding specific public employees under Virginia Code 2.2-3711 and consultation with legal counsel employed or retained by a public body pertaining to probable litigation where such litigation or a briefing in open meeting would adversely affect the negotiating or litigating posture of the public body regarding a matter related
to Loudoun Circuit Court Matter CL-22-3129 as authorized by Section 2.2-3711A7 of the Code of Virginia. Is there a second? Seconded by Ms. Okedegbe. Is there any discussion?

Seeing none, all those in favor of the motion to convene the closed meeting, please raise your hand and say aye. Aye. That motion will pass unanimously of board members present with Mehelleby and Corpo absent
for the vote we are now in closed session back the board is coming out of closed session i move that

the closed meeting be adjourned that the loudon county school board reconvene its public meeting and that the minutes of the public meeting reflect that no formal action was taken in the closed meeting i further move that the following resolution certifying the closed meeting be adopted and reflected in the minutes of this public meeting resolution number 24-2223 whereas the loudon county school board has convened a closed meeting on this date pursuant to an affirmative recorded vote and in accordance with the provisions of the Virginia Freedom of Information Act and whereas section 2.2-3712d of the Code of Virginia requires a certification by the school board that such closed meeting was conducted in conformity with Virginia law now

therefore be it resolved that the Loudoun County School Board hereby certifies that to the best of each member's knowledge only public business matters lawfully exempted from open meeting requirements by Virginia law were discussed in the closed meeting to which the certification applies and only such public business matters as were identified in the motion convening the closed meeting were heard discussed or considered by the Loudoun County School Board second seconded by mr. Morse is there any discussion seeing none all those in favor please raise your hands and say aye aye that motion will pass unanimously of board members present with Corbeau Mejedevi and Rieser absent
for the vote and seeing no further business, we are adjourned.
